objectClass.primaryType: offroad SUV (Jeep Wrangler TJ-style, stylized/low-poly, 10% stretched wheelbase)
objectClass.notes: 8-view turnaround sheet (front/rear/side/top/3-4 front/3-4 rear/all-sides lineup/underside silhouette) plus an explicit spec panel: low-poly/stylized, mobile-game target, ~4800 tris, 1024x1024 textures, 2 materials (body+glass) per the sheet's own budget, matte/simplified color palette of 6 swatches. Treat the sheet's stated budget as a target ceiling; the sculpt spec itself will need more than 2 semantic materials (paint/trim/glass/rubber/metal/lenses) even if several share one shader/atlas at implementation time.

reasoning: Silhouette is boxy but interrupted by wheel arches, fender flares, roof/body color break, and the tailgate-mounted spare tire bulge (score 2/3, not a simple box).
Component count is high: hood, grille, 2x bumper, 4x fender flare, 2x rocker rail, 2x door, roof, tailgate, 2x mirror, 2x headlight, 2x turn signal, 2x taillight, 4x road wheel + spare (score 3/3).
Hierarchy is 2-3 levels deep: body -> panel (door/fender/bumper) -> local feature (handle/vent/lens), and wheel -> rim/tire -> tread lug / lug nut (score 2/3).
Repetition systems: 4x identical road wheels + 1 spare, 7 grille slats, tread lug pattern per tire, lug nuts per rim (score 2/3).

Material layers: body paint, black trim plastic, tinted glass, tire rubber, wheel metal, headlight lens, taillight lens (red), turn-signal lens (amber), roll-cage metal, underbody (score 2/3, 9 distinct surfaces).
Local detail density: grille slats, tread pattern, rock rails, hood vents, door seams, roll-cage brace seen through glass (score 2/3).
Occlusion risk is low-moderate: interior mostly hidden but roll cage is inferable through rear quarter glass, underside is shown directly in the lineup panel (score 1/3).

Action-readiness: 4 wheels need rotation pivots, doors/tailgate need hinge pivots, spare tire is a detachable-style mount -- a real game prop needs these even though the sheet targets a static low-poly asset (score 2/3).
Overall judgment: many visible subparts, multiple materials, several hierarchy levels, and real repetition systems -> complex tier, not moderate.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Choose simple/moderate/complex/ultra-complex from observed structure, not from a hardcoded domain.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from scripts/extract_reference_landmarks.py. See references/character-reconstruction.md and references/likeness-maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: Silhouette reads unmistakably as a boxy 2-door Wrangler-style offroad SUV from all 8 reference viewpoints (front, rear, side, top, 3/4 front, 3/4 rear, lineup, underside).
Two-tone color break (tan/khaki body vs matte-black roof/trim) and the 6-swatch palette from the spec panel are reproduced in albedo.

Grille (7 slats), round headlights + amber turn signals, red taillight clusters, tailgate-mounted spare tire, roll-cage X-brace seen through rear glass, and 4x tread-patterned wheels with spoked rims are all present and placed at reference proportions.
Wheels, doors, and tailgate are on real pivots/sockets (action-ready), not fused into one static mesh.

featureGroups.name: Boxy body silhouette + tan/black two-tone color break
qualityCriteria: Body mass reads as a flat-hood, vertical-windshield, boxy SUV with a distinct black hardtop roof mass sitting on a tan/khaki lower body.
Roof-to-body color break sits at the beltline as in reference, not blended.
failureModes: model reads as a generic rounded car instead of a flat-panel Wrangler-style box
roof and body share one color/material

featureGroups.name: Grille, round headlights, amber turn signals
qualityCriteria: 7-slat vertical grille centered between two circular headlights with raised bezels.
Trapezoidal amber turn-signal lenses sit at the fender corners below the headlights.
failureModes: grille is a flat painted texture instead of repeated slat geometry
headlights are square/generic instead of round sealed-beam

featureGroups.name: Taillights, tailgate, spare tire
qualityCriteria: Rectangular red taillight clusters at both rear corners.
Full-size spare tire + matching rim mounted on the tailgate, contributing to rear silhouette overhang.
failureModes: spare tire is missing or painted onto the tailgate instead of modeled as a mounted wheel
taillights are the wrong color or shape

featureGroups.name: Roll-cage X-brace visible through rear quarter glass
qualityCriteria: A dark X-shaped brace plus header bar is visible through the tinted rear quarter windows, not a flat dark window texture.
failureModes: windows render as opaque or featureless dark panels with no interior structure hint

featureGroups.name: 4x repeated road wheels + spare: tread pattern + spoked rim
qualityCriteria: All 4 road wheels (and the spare) share one instanced/repeated wheel assembly: chunky all-terrain tread lugs + 5-6 spoke dark rim + lug nuts.
Wheels sit on rotation pivots at the axle centerline.
failureModes: wheels are smooth cylinders with no tread or spoke detail
each wheel is authored as an unrelated one-off mesh instead of a shared repetition system

featureGroups.name: Fender flares, rocker rails, front/rear bumpers with tow hooks
qualityCriteria: Matte-black fender flares wrap all 4 wheel openings as a distinct material break from the body paint.
Rocker rail runs the full wheelbase between wheel openings; front/rear bumpers are chunky black with visible tow-hook loops.
failureModes: fender flares are the same color as the body (missing material break)
bumpers are flush with the body instead of a separate protruding component

featureGroups.name: Doors, mirrors, wipers, hood vents
qualityCriteria: Single door per side with a visible seam and a recessed paddle handle; boxy side mirrors on the A-pillar; two wiper arms at the windshield base; small hood vent bumps near the cowl.
failureModes: door/handle/mirror/wiper details are omitted, leaving a featureless body flank

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every wheel, door, tailgate, spare-tire mount, and mirror has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: a wheel or spare tire floats away from its wheel well/mount bracket
door/tailgate pivots are centered on the part instead of on the hinge line

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: 9 independent materials (body paint, black trim, glass, tire rubber, wheel metal, headlight lens, taillight lens, turn-signal lens, roll-cage metal) with independent albedo/roughness, not one texture reused across channels.
Macro (panel color blocks), meso (flare/rail seams, grille slats), and micro (tread lugs, lug nuts, bezel bevels) frequency bands are all represented.
failureModes: surface looks like flat plastic with no roughness variation between paint/trim/glass/rubber
local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Albedo palette matches the reference's 6-swatch legend (tan body, near-black trim/roof, 2 mid-grays, near-black, red).
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
failureModes: colors are a generic average instead of the reference-observed palette
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

visualDeltaChecks: silhouette and negative-space delta (wheel arch gaps, greenhouse shape, spare-tire overhang)
repetition density and distribution delta (4x wheels, grille slats, tread lugs, lug nuts)
material albedo/roughness/normal response delta (paint vs trim vs glass vs rubber vs metal vs lenses)
local feature placement and scale delta (headlight/taillight/mirror/handle positions)
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
